digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, code-drift invalidation, attestation signing
propositions: 21% of full re-reviews were triggered by byte-identical material due to unbounded SHA-drift fail-safe when file_impact was undeclared, causing over-triggering
The normalized read-set (tool==read_file paths, resolved and deduplicated) is recorded in the signed manifest as read-path entries plus read-set marker, making it binding to verification

Drift invalidation with empty declared set and undeclared scope now composes read-set plus blast-radius globs (criteria files, rebar.toml, reviewers) through the ADR-0002 content-hash machinery, narrowing the fail-safe
The currency-basis field in the manifest records whether invalidation is scoped to file_impact, read-set, or fail-safe, enabling clients to report and audit the decision basis
Pre-change attestations, unverifiable read-sets, and glob-expansion failures safely fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation without false negatives
